expectation: Nuclear stain in naive and stem-like memory T cells, plus some NK/ILC cells. Moderately common, concentrated in lymphoid aggregates and follicle T zones, with scattered single cells in the lamina propria. Epithelium and stroma should be negative.
observed: A: gut rolls with a tissue-shaped yellow haze and glow off the tissue; small bright aggregates stand out. B/C: epithelial haze, debris and a few bright cells. D: round, nucleus-sized bright cells. E: dense TCF1 nuclei overlap the CD3E-rich core (white).
why: Nucleus-sized TCF1+ cells sit in lymphoid aggregates and on the CD3E-dense core, as expected, above a high diffuse background.
notes: There is a lot of background haze and off-tissue glow, but D shows distinct nuclear-sized positive cells, and in row E TCF1 nuclei pack the CD3E-dense aggregate core (white overlap). Some green also lies outside CD3E.
